   /root/edfinder-v3-benchmark                            (~23.6 GB, PostgreSQL 18 benchmarking leftovers from August)

WHAT:
1. New script scripts/operator/actions/v3-host-cleanup.sh (python3 -I -B standard library for the logic, same host-identity check against deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json as other actions, hard wall clock <= 1800 s). The allowlist is a FIXED constant in the script; nothing about paths may come from workflow inputs, environment or arguments. For each allowlisted path, in order:
   - if absent: record `already_absent` and continue;
   - refuse (record and skip, final status stopped) unless ALL hold: os.lstat shows a real directory (not a symlink); realpath equals the literal path; every parent component is not a symlink; the path is not a mount point and st_dev equals the st_dev of / (no other filesystem); the path is not, and does not contain, any Docker volume mountpoint or /var/lib/docker; the path is not the PostgreSQL data directory and contains no PG_VERSION file at any depth; owner uid is 0;
   - for /data/v3/source-artifacts/spansh/2026-08-24T205426Z additionally require that no running process has a file open under it (scan /proc/*/fd readlinks) — refuse otherwise;
   - measure bytes with `du -sx -B1` before; delete with `rm -rf --one-file-system -- <path>`; verify the path is absent afterwards; record bytes_freed.
   - Never delete a parent directory; never glob; never follow symlinks.
   Receipt (one JSON line): per-path outcome (removed / already_absent / refused with reason), bytes before, total_bytes_freed, root df before/after, filesystem_writes_performed (true only if something was removed), db_writes_performed=false, service_changes_performed=false, status success only if every path ended removed or already_absent.
2. Add operation `v3-host-cleanup` to .github/workflows/chatgpt-ed-new-ops.yml (closed choice list + allowlist case), wired like the other mutating actions (same ssh/elevation pattern), receipt uploaded as artifact `v3-host-cleanup-receipt`, and ALSO a compact `::notice title=Host clean-up::<text>` annotation summarising per-path outcome and bytes freed (escape % CR LF; < 4000 chars) — the owner and reviewer cannot download artifacts or read logs. It must NOT be callable via any other path, and must not run in parallel with the derived purge: use the same concurrency group the other production-mutating ops use (check the workflow; the purge workflow uses v3-production-application-authority).
3. Tests (pytest, no real host): the allowlist is exactly those four literal paths; workflow inputs/env cannot change it; symlinked path, symlinked parent, mount point / different st_dev, PG_VERSION inside, Docker volume path inside, non-root owner, open file under the Spansh path -> refused and nothing removed; absent -> already_absent; happy path removes and verifies absence (use a temp directory tree with the checks pointed at it through a test-only seam that production cannot reach, e.g. a module-level ROOT used only by tests, or run the logic function against tmp paths); the summary annotation escaping. Extend the ops-workflow contract tests for the new operation. Authority gate must pass with failures []. Update operator docs listing ops operations.
